newsitem.title: USA: Robotic Vision sees Q4 breakeven or loss.
newsitem.headline: Robotic Vision sees Q4 breakeven or loss.

text.p: Robotic Vision Systems Inc said Friday results are expected to be at breakeven or reflect a slight loss for the fourth quarter ended September 30.
The First Call consensus estimate for the quarter was earnings of $0.12 per share compared with reported earnings of $0.19 a year earlier.
The company attributed these expectations, based on a preliminary review of its unaudited fiscal fourth quarter results, to several factors:
-- The acquisition of Computer Identics, which closed on August 30, resulted in higher than expected merger expenses.
-- Computer Identics' results reflect lower fourth quarter revenue and net income than expected.
-- The fourth quarter is also the first in which the company is incurring significant taxes on income from its core electronics division.
The company also said its fourth quarter will include merger expenses associated with the acquisition of Systemation Engineered Products, which closed October 1.
